items.title: Trump announces deal for Russian diesel as Zelensky calls it a gift to Putin
items.summary: Ukraine's president sharply criticised the move, calling it an "investment in war that must be ended, not prolonged".

items.title: 'Cockroach' group leaders among hundreds detained in Delhi protest
items.summary: Tens of thousands of security personnel were deployed and roads barricaded ahead of the demonstration.

items.title: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 15 people including three children
items.summary: Children are among the victims, authorities say, and more victims could still be buried in the rubble of a large apartment block that was destroyed.

items.title: Head of Met's volunteer force fired after AI tool found deleted intimate images on work phone
items.summary: Special chief officer James Deller copied intimate images on to his work phone, AI monitoring finds.

items.title: Rogue Anthropic AI agent gave US police fake tip in unsolved murder case
items.summary: Philadelphia police said the tip was "flagged as spam", but criticised the tech company for taking more than two months to detect and report the breach.

items.title: Drumcree parade ban was in interests of peace, says Bryant
items.summary: The decision followed a warning from the chief constable that allowing the procession to go ahead could lead to serious injury, disorder and wider unrest across Northern Ireland.

items.title: France's school protests are about more than broken classrooms
items.summary: Students taking to the streets have become a focal point in the country's increasingly polarised politics.

items.title: I couldn't access my family's medical history - not knowing was terrifying
items.summary: People who have been adopted or are in care sometimes struggle to access family medical history which could be crucial to their own health.
